newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Parent places Far East Aluminium shares.
newsitem.headline: Parent places Far East Aluminium shares.

text.p: Far East Aluminium (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday its controlling shareholder Panorama International Ltd would place 35 million existing company shares to independent third parties at HK$2.30 per share.
Panorama's stake in the company will be reduced to 60.2 percent from 71.6 percent on completion of the placing on June 27, Far East Aluminium said.
Panorma has no present intention to dispose of more shares but may re-assess its shareholding and may consider disposing of further shares if the need should arise, it said.
Shares of the curtain wall and aluminium works contractor resumed trading on Wednesday after a one-day suspension and were up HK$0.225 to HK$2.725 at midday.
